items.description: Retractable main landing gear strut using Technic angle connectors, an axle, and pins to mount a rubber tyred wheel.
items.finding: Keep wheel-strut geometry in one source pose; retractable is not demonstrated. Preserve parent mounts; no checked travel claim.

items.description: A jet engine pod featuring a fan, engine housing, cone intake, and curved slope fairing.
items.finding: Keep fan housing and long thin pylon; four parent placements clarify attachment.

items.description: A landing gear assembly of four wheels with tyres, wheel pins, and mounting plates.
items.finding: Keep four-wheel, two-axle bogie and short upright mount with two parent placements.

items.description: Roof dormer frame of plates, an arch and a technic brick
items.finding: Keep arched opening, Technic holes and paired clips as roof-panel detail.

items.description: A red and green semi truck cab built on a car base with wheel plates, grille tile, and trans-clear light plates.
items.finding: Rename to complete compact tractor unit: white cab, red stripe, green grille, four-wheel chassis and rear turntable. Not just a cab.

items.description: Arched tan element with embossed brick, open-stud round plates, and tall bricks forming a window surround.
items.finding: Keep narrow textured tan arch with round-spacer cornice; merge source with arcade-bay recipe.

items.description: First-floor balcony - turquoise brick railing with dark-blue slopes forming a dormered bay, a white roof-window, brown door and trim, plus small floral accents on a tan/white plate base.
items.finding: Keep sloped blue dormer/window bay, turquoise wall and black ornamental railing with brown top. Correct turquoise-railing description.

items.description: An angled red and dark blue bow section built from sloped bricks and side-stud bricks forming the ship's front.
items.finding: Keep faceted red/blue bow. Include parent orientation: isolated view appears upright.

items.description: second floor fire escape — parts: dark bluish grey Plate 2x3; light bluish grey Plate 1x2; light bluish grey Plate 2x12; black Panel 1x2x1 with Square Corners; 4x black Tile 1x1 with Clip; black Bar 1x4x3 with End Protrusions; 2x black Minifig Mechanical Arm with Clips Parallel; black Minifig Speargun
items.finding: Keep platform/rail detail with long support plate and bar/clip railing; not a complete stair flight.

items.description: Left wing assembly combining large yellow pentagonal and rectangular wing plates with black mounting plates, grille surface detail, and trans-orange and dark bluish grey grille vents.
items.finding: Keep tapered wing with actual bar/clip root: 60478 handle plates, not hinge fingers. No validated sweep claim.

items.description: Tree model built from round brown trunk bricks topped with multiple layers of green leaf foliage on a green base plate.
items.finding: Keep round brown trunk, three foliage layers and base as landscaping lesson.

items.description: A compact yellow cab section featuring wheel pins, grille tiles, headlight bricks, a sloped windscreen, and a turntable for hitching to a trailer.
items.finding: Rename complete compact four-wheel tractor unit with rear hitch; geometry extends beyond cab.

items.description: Staircase up to the second floor: reddish-brown plates and a 7x4x6 open staircase element
items.finding: Keep moulded stairs and landing with actual floor opening shown in parent.

items.description: A street lamppost with a white round base, grey bar post, transparent yellow light dome, and a green leafy decoration on top.
items.finding: Keep white base, grey post, clear cup/yellow bulb and green/red decoration alongside post. Decoration is not on top.

items.description: A white and dark blue park bench built from plates and corner tiles.
items.finding: Keep dark-blue seat/back and white feet as small furniture lesson.

items.description: Rear wheel bogie — single-axle train wheelset, minifig-head buffers, buffer beam, magnetic coupling, coupler and bogie plate
items.finding: Keep two-axle bogie, central pivot, buffers and coupling. Correct single-axle source/card descriptions: two single-axle parts form one bogie.

items.description: Nose/cockpit shell section: 4x6 plate with 1x12 and 1x6 bricks, panels, a curved-top brick and a 1x6 arch
items.finding: Rename paired rounded body-side covers. Non-ghost parent view places these around the wing mechanism beside the body; cockpit/nose identity is incorrect. Curved-skin reuse elsewhere must be described as adaptation.

items.description: A brown framed window with two grey shutters and two blue panes.
items.finding: Keep brown frame, grey shutters and blue open frames; avoid calling open frames glass panes.

items.description: Vertical tail fin built from a yellow plate and black 45-degree slopes with side-stud brick and a trans-red slope navigation light on top.
items.finding: Keep thin black fin, yellow plate and translucent-red top; parent role agrees.

items.description: A medium-sized tree with a reddish brown and dark bluish grey trunk supporting green leaf clusters.
items.finding: Keep cone/round trunk and large leaf blades as a distinct small tree construction.

items.description: A blue left-side hatch assembly mirroring the right, with inverted slopes, a hinge base, bracket, tail fin, and a light grey engine cone.
items.finding: Keep blue hinged rear hatch with nozzle/fin. Inherited colour differs between preview and parent. One pose does not certify travel.

items.description: A brown and grey wheeled landing gear unit with four wide rubber tyres, rims, hinges, and orange accent slopes.
items.finding: Rename small vehicle chassis/wheel module. Whole-source view shows separate wheeled buggy in multi-object scene, not spacecraft landing gear. Remove deployed-landing-clearance guidance.

items.description: A small black armchair built on a turntable base with brackets and a minifig seat.
items.finding: Keep compact black chair and turntable mount. Static-pose scope only; swivel clearance not verified.

items.description: Castle side wall section with corner panels, shuttered window, and arched brickwork in red and black.
items.finding: Keep printed corner panels, window and arched roof supports as facade detail.

items.description: Dark and black loading ramp with grille tiles, transparent red accent plates, and handled end plates for a folding surface.
items.finding: Keep paired wheel tracks and bar ends; parent shows upright stowed ramp behind truck. No checked-motion claim.

items.description: A small forklift vehicle with wheels, a forklift mast, and a control stick for lifting cargo.
items.finding: Keep complete minifigure forklift: mast, forks, seat, levers, wheels. Isolated inherited colour may differ from source parent. No validated working-lift claim.

items.description: Outdoor street lamp with a black pole, inverted dish shade, and a glowing yellow light element.
items.finding: Keep thin black post, yellow light, inverted shade and green wreath/red accent.

recipes.finding: Fresh home view shows narrow tan arch, tall piers, round spacers and cornice. Keep adjustable-height recipe beside classical-arch-bay source; articulated means architectural detail, not motion.
Fresh home view shows narrow round-brick post, open collar, translucent yellow lamp, inverted dish cap and square foot. Keep adjustable-height recipe.

limits: Static visual and semantic audit, not new fit, motion or load validation. Decisions provisional pending metadata and stated check scopes. Library DAT primitives are dependencies, not separately curated construction examples.
